description: The Kestrel Row Tool Library's help bot: a system prompt, a member handbook it answers from, and the questions members ask; proctor and nb are built into its image

run: apt-get update -q && apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends jq >/dev/null && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
git clone -q https://github.com/breitreiter/nb.git /opt/nb && git -C /opt/nb checkout -q 0e11b218f1a3da09f71417f9e9e1b63b6d4d6286 && cd /opt/nb && dotnet build -nologo -v q

git clone -q https://github.com/breitreiter/proctor.git /opt/proctor && cd /opt/proctor && git checkout -q 76494f192dc303d4b4bb5256702bb4fc1e04e7b2 && rm -rf .git suites/agent-onboarding fixtures/onboarding-* && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.name=proctor -c user.email=proctor@localhost commit -qm 'proctor 76494f192dc303d4b4bb5256702bb4fc1e04e7b2' && dotnet build -nologo -v q
for d in /root/.claude/skills /root/.qwen/skills; do mkdir -p $d && cp -r /opt/proctor/skills/proctor-suite $d/; done
